global_issues.title: 10y yield at 4.9% and Fed hike odds surge on oil-driven inflation
global_issues.note: 10y yield closed 2026-09-10 at ~4.845-4.92% (highest since 2023), CME FedWatch showing ~59-65% odds of a Fed hike next week after hot PPI (+0.4% MoM) and ahead of CPI. Directionally and numerically correct, though briefing's framing of 'oil-driven inflation' omits the actual root cause: oil is spiking because of active US-Iran military conflict (tanker strikes, Persian Gulf attacks), not a generic supply/demand move. That geopolitical driver is the more newsworthy fact and is missing.

grok_report.summary: The briefing's core numbers (10y yield ~4.9%, Fed hike odds rising, tech under pressure) are accurate and current, and sector rotation logic holds up. However, it materially omits the actual driver of the oil/yield spike — active US-Iran military escalation with strikes on tankers and bases — which is the top market-moving story of the last 24h and arguably should elevate the mood rating beyond 'yellow' given four consecutive down days across major indices.
